data.name: Rampukar
data.long_meaning: Ram-pū-kar means 'God of Rama's Army'. In Hindu mythology, Rama is an incarnation of the god Vishnu and the prince of Ayodhya. The army of Rama, known as the Vanara Sena, was a group of monkey and bear soldiers who helped Rama in his war against the demon king Ravana. Pū-kar can be translated to 'warrior' or 'soldier'. Therefore, the name Rampukar signifies a brave and powerful warrior who fights for justice and righteousness.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rampukar is a name that embodies devotion, courage, and strength. It is a reminder that even in the face of adversity, we can find the inner strength to overcome obstacles and fight for our beliefs. This name is also a tribute to the god Rama and the courageous Vanara soldiers who stood by him in his battle against evil.
